places-la-cova-dels-tolls-alts-abric-de-.story: From Albocàsser it runs 164 km to Albocàsser; allow about 2 h 50 of riding. On the way it passes Abric del mas dels Ous, Galeria del Roure, Abric de la Tenalla and back through Galeria del Roure. The highest point is about 1,100 m. The line favours views over speed.
